energy_accounting_note: Spiking energies include the T=8 temporal integration factor (T*r_bar*FLOPs*e_SOP); dense baselines perform a single forward pass and carry no T factor. Corrected 2026-10-15.

notes.significance_family: Family enlarged from 58 to 60 cells so that Proto-GAT's two 10-versus-5-run cells (DD and Rdt-M5k, 1-shot) are treated exactly like the other baselines' unequal-count cells, i.e. by Welch's test rather than by exclusion. BH-FDR recomputed over all 60. Effect sizes: paired cells report Cohen's d_z; the 12 Welch cells report standard Cohen's d with the df-weighted pooled SD.
